Pain au Chocolat Recipe 🍫🥐 An Delight of Tender Chocolate and Airy Pastry. The classic elegance of Pain au Chocolat enchants taste buds around the world. This French pastry is an irresistible delicacy, weaving its magic across palates. It's an experience that shouldn't be missed. Makes 8-10 pieces 🥛 Dough: - 180 ml chilled milk - 18 g sugar - 25 g fresh yeast - 35 g cold butter - About 6 g salt - 380 g flour (Type 550) 🍫 Filling: - 160 g cold butter - 16-20 dark chocolate strips 🥚 Brushing: - Egg yolk - 1 tbsp cream/milk 👩🏻‍🍳 Dough Prep: 1. Mix dough ingredients in a kitchen mixer, knead for 5 min. 2. Take needed butter from the fridge for lamination. 3. Roll dough to 21x25 cm. Lamination: 1. Halve 160 g butter lengthwise. 2. Fold dough over butter, wrap, chill 45+ min. 1st Turn: 1. Roll dough to 8-10 mm, fold in thirds, chill 45+ min. 2nd Turn: 1. Treat rolled dough, fold, chill 45+ min. 3rd Turn: 1. Roll, fold, chill 1-2 hours. 🥐 Shaping and Baking: 1. Roll proofed dough to 15x4 mm. 2. Cut 15 cm x 8.5 cm strips. 3. Place halved chocolate bars on dough, roll. 4. Put rolled dough, seams down, on parchment-lined sheet. 5. Proof 2-2.5 hours at room temp. 6. Brush with egg yolk, cream/milk mixture. 7. Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F), bake 20 min. Optional: Brush with maple syrup after baking. Enjoy your homemade Pain au Chocolat! 🥐🍫  #painauchocolat #dessert #cake #dessertrecipe

Dubai chocolate is a viral, thick chocolate bar filled with crunchy, pistachio-flavored shredded kadayif pastry. Key ingredients include 150-200g milk/dark chocolate, 100g kadayif (shredded filo), 100g pistachio cream, 1 tbsp tahini, and 1 tbsp butter. Melt chocolate in a mold, mix toasted, chopped pastry with creams, fill, seal, and chill.  Key Components Shell: 200g - 300g milk or dark chocolate Filling: 100g-150g kadayif (shredded filo pastry), 100g-175g pistachio cream/paste, 1-2 tbsp tahini, 30g-40g butter  Instructions Prepare the Shell: Melt the chocolate (tempering is recommended for a professional snap) and coat the bottom and sides of a chocolate mold. Freeze for 10-15 minutes until set. Make the Filling: Finely chop the kadayif pastry and toast it in butter over medium heat until golden brown and crispy (approx. 10 mins). Combine Filling: In a bowl, mix the toasted kadayif, pistachio cream, tahini, and a pinch of salt. Assemble: Fill the hardened chocolate shell with the mixture, pressing down firmly. Seal: Pour the remaining melted chocolate over the filling to create the back of the bar. Set: Chill in the fridge for 20-30 minutes until completely firm, then remove from the mold.  Optional Decorative Touch Drizzle melted white chocolate (mixed with green food coloring) into the mold before adding the main chocolate layer for a signature look #jinx #jinxarcane #jinxedit #viarcaneedit #zaytxr
